links.outcome: Model accuracy on external multi-center data versus internal test set
links.effect: Internal six-class accuracy 0.83-0.85; external centres (Xinjiang, Guizhou, Fujian) 0.74-0.82 six-class and 0.79-0.86 normal/abnormal, so accuracy fell at external sites but remained satisfactory.
links.quote: Multi-center real-world data validation demonstrated satisfactory accuracy, with a range of 0.74-0.82 for six-class classification and 0.79-0.86 for normal/abnormal classification, indicating strong generalizability.

screen.reason: The study develops and validates a deep-learning model on newborn ear images from multiple centres and compares its diagnostic performance against human readers (prospective dataset and multi-centre external validation). It does not test a deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
